senses.gloss: m. (עצץ, v. אֲצִיצָא) a common earthen vessel (used for refuse).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 3:4">Keth. III, 4</cite> <he>האונס שותה בעֲצִיצוֹ</he> the ravisher must drink out of the offensive vessel he has chosen, expl.
ib. 5 אפי׳ היא חיגית וכ׳ he must marry the woman, even if she be lame &c.—Esp. flower-pot.
<cite ref="Mishnah Demai 5:10">Dem. V, 10</cite> <he>ע׳ נקוב וכ׳</he> that which grows in a perforated pot (placed in the ground) is legally like that which grows in the ground itself.
<cite ref="Menachot 70a:6">Men. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ שאינו נקוב</he> a pot without a hole.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 7:8">Kil. VII, 8</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>עֲצִיצִים</he>. Y.
